title: Baghouse ID fan, vibration trips from build-up on impeller
tests: Messy multi-cause; forced; wet feed and bag leak competing explanations.
summary: Cement plant baghouse ID fan tripped on high vibration four times in a month. Impeller blades had uneven dust build-up. Candidates: wet raw material, a leaking bag row, low gas temperature dew-point. The tree has two plausible branches but the root is a single physical statement.

problem.title: High vibration trips on baghouse ID fan F-402
problem.site: Cement plant, raw mill area, Hunter Valley NSW
problem.whatHappened: F-402 tripped on high vibration four times between 10 Feb and 11 Mar 2026. Each time the impeller was found with an uneven crust of dust on several blades, which was chipped off. Vibration returned within a week.
problem.where: Impeller blades and housing of F-402.
problem.when: Worse after wet weather and after raw mill restarts.
problem.impact: Raw mill stopped for 3 to 6 hours on each trip, about 4.5 h average, and kiln feed reduced.
problem.duty: Kiln raw mill baghouse induced draught, continuous

evidence.title: Impeller build-up
evidence.note: Uneven crust, up to 25 mm thick, on 5 of 12 blades. Material hard and damp when chipped.

evidence.title: Baghouse inlet gas temperature trend
evidence.note: Inlet drops to about 85 C at raw mill restarts; no preheat on the baghouse.

evidence.title: Fan vibration trend
evidence.note: Vibration rises slowly over 5 to 7 days then trips; 1x component dominates.

evidence.title: Baghouse differential pressure
evidence.note: Rising over the month; two compartments isolated for bag leaks not yet repaired.

capa.deteriorationReasoning: Dust sticking to the blades comes from damp gas and bag leaks, conditions we allow. It is not normal wear.

preventive.what: Preheat or hold baghouse inlet gas temperature above a set limit before restarting the raw mill
Baghouse inlet temperature low alarm and differential pressure trend with limits
Repair leaking bag rows within a set time and replace bags
preventive.interval: next planned stop and each leak

preventive.what: Fan vibration trend with a review of the 1x trend
Hold a spare impeller or a refurbished rotor for F-402
